name: Conjure Water Elemental
description: (Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)(Tag:water)Conjure or summon Water and Ice Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Nereids, High Water Fairies, Undines, etc., or similar beings using water-based magic. Limited to Rare Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.
